hook.say: True or false? Five facts about Asia, three seconds each. The last one catches people out!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Kazakhstan is the world's largest landlocked country.
questions.fact: It is the ninth-largest country on Earth and has no ocean coast.
questions.sayAnswer: True! It is the ninth-largest country on Earth, with no ocean coastline.

questions.fact: Bali is an island and a province of Indonesia.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Bali is an island and a province of Indonesia.

questions.q: The Maldives is the lowest-lying country on Earth.
questions.fact: Its natural ground rises no more than about 2.4 m above the sea.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Its natural ground rises only about 2 meters above the sea.

questions.q: China, as wide as the continental US, uses just one time zone.
questions.say: China, as wide as the continental U.S., uses just one time zone.
questions.fact: China spans five geographic time zones but uses only Beijing time.
questions.sayAnswer: True! China spans 5 geographic time zones but officially uses only Beijing time.

questions.q: Most Russians live in the Asian part of Russia.
questions.fact: About 80% of Russia's people live in the European part.
questions.sayAnswer: False! About 80 percent of Russia's people live in the European part.
